extracted.name: Zingy grapefruit, prawn, avocado & tamarind salad
extracted.description: Add vibrant colours and fresh flavours to your plate with this blush red grapefruit salad, with prawn, avocado and tamarind. It's a lovely lunch or starter
ingredient_lines: 3cm piece of ginger peeled and finely grated
2 ripe avocados stoned, peeled and thinly sliced
2 red grapefruits peeled, pith removed, sliced into rounds
½ small bunch of coriander leaves picked and torn
instruction_lines: Combine the sesame oil, tamarind, garlic, ginger, fish sauce and lime juice. Taste and add more fish sauce if needed, then season to taste.
Arrange the avocado, grapefruit rounds, radishes and prawns on a serving platter. Drizzle over the dressing and scatter with the sesame seeds and coriander.
